title: uva-ursi glauca
intro: Uva-ursi glauca, commonly known as bearberry, is a low-growing, evergreen shrub native to the mountainous regions of North America and Europe. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing the severity of urinary tract infections (UTIs) due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of uva-ursi glauca include acting as an anti-inflammatory and astringent, which can help to soothe and protect the mucous membranes in the urinary tract. The bioactive constituents of this plant include arbutin, hydroquinone, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
